future_data_leakage.evidence: Regimes at bar t are computed using strictly trailing 24h rolling volatility and momentum. Expanding historical quantiles use only bars <= t.

forward_return_alignment.evidence: Forward return R(t, t+H) = (Close(t+H) - Close(t)) / Close(t). No overlap into feature computation.

embargo_between_partitions.evidence: 72h embargo between annual walk-forward folds prevents forward-return contamination.

prefix_invariance.evidence: Sub-sampling and chronological truncation preserves exact regime classification for historical prefixes.
